nodes.label: MockQtModule Strategy for Docs Build Without Qt
nodes.rationale: PySide6/PyQtGraph cannot be installed in the docs build environment. A custom MockQtModule with MagicMock patches is used so Sphinx autodoc can import xpcsviewer submodules without needing real Qt. Internal Qt-dependent submodules are also pre-registered as types.ModuleType so Sphinx gets proper __name__ attributes.
